title: Countably rectifiable sets are covered by C¹ submanifolds up to a null set (Simon Ch. 3, Lemma 1.2, “only if”)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be countably m-rectifiable (CountablyRectifiable m M: M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j F_j(ℝ^m) with H^m(M₀) = 0 and Lipschitz F_j : ℝ^m → ℝ^P; H^m = μHE[m]). Then there are a set N₀ ⊆ ℝ^P with H^m(N₀) = 0 and sets N_l ⊆ ℝ^P (l ∈ ℕ), each an embedded m-dimensional C¹ submanifold of ℝ^P in the sense of the contract (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m N_l: every point of N_l has an open W ∋ y and a C¹ map ψ on an open V ⊆ ℝ^m, injective on V, with ψ(V) = W ∩ N_l, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) compact for compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(z) injective for z ∈ V), such that M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃_l N_l.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), CountablyRectifiable m M → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Euclid P)) (N : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), μHE[m] N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ l, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m (N l)) ∧ M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ l, N l
